description: Remove a member from a group (the group is rebuilt with the remaining members, or dissolved if fewer than 2 remain)

groupIndex.description: Index of the group to remove the item from, as numbered by list_groups (its index in page.allPageItems)

itemIndex.description: Index of the member within the group (group.pageItems), as listed by get_group_info; not the list_page_items numbering

pageIndex.description: Index of the page containing the group (0-based)

name: remove_item_from_group
title: Remove Item From Group
